subject: general
question: Which of the following does NOT match?

options.text: Compass- used for navigation and indicates north-south directions
Electroscope- detects the presence of electric charge
Actinometer- measures the intensity of radiation

solution:
The correct answer is __**Cyclotron- measures small magnitude Cyclones.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cyclotron** is a type of particle accelerator that is used to accelerate charged particles to high energies.
 
• It does not measure small magnitude cyclones; rather, it is used in physics and medical applications to study subatomic particles and produce radioactive isotopes.
 
• It employs a magnetic field and an electric field to accelerate particles in a spiral path.
 
• The term "cyclone" refers to a meteorological phenomenon, whereas a cyclotron is a device used in particle physics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Compass** is a navigational instrument used for determining direction relative to the Earth's magnetic poles.
 
• **Electroscope** is a device used to detect the presence and magnitude of electric charge.
 
• **Actinometer** is an instrument used for measuring the intensity of radiation, typically solar radiation.
 
• Each of these instruments has specific applications within their respective fields of study or usage.
